None of us had been to Canada before, and we thought it would be fun if we all went together. We requested time off work, bought flights, made hotel reservations, etc. The trip is scheduled for March. Here's the problem: a month we made all these arrangements, my wife was arrested for drunk driving, and she pleaded guilty to the charge this week. My understanding is that she can no longer enter Canada with a DUI on her record. But I still want to go on the trip, which I paid a lot of money for, and I told our friends I still plan on accompanying them. My wife and I got into a huge fight over it, and she accused me of being selfish and unsupportive for wanting to go without her. I don't think that's fair. I've supported her throughout the entire court process, which has been incredibly stressful and expensive, and I've been looking forward to this trip for a long time. WIBTA?
